Commentary.Commentary: Right! That caps of the first T20I! The Kiwis go 1-0 up which is always a good thing in a 3-match series. Pakistan will look to make a comeback in the next encounter. The second game will be played on Sunday, 20th December 2020 at Hamilton. The action will begin at 1900 local (0600 GMT). We will look for your company for that game. Until then, it is goodbye from our side. Cheers!

Mitchell Santner, the Kiwi skipper, starts by saying that it was a great performance from the lads with the ball. Praises Jacob Duffy for the way he stepped up. Is pleased for the boys. Says the confidence is high for the team and the energy in the field was outstanding. Says they are looking forward to the World Cup in India and are looking to give different guys an opportunity. Ends by informing that there could be a few changes in the next game as a few of their star players return to the team.

Pakistan skipper, Shadab Khan, says it was a good comeback by the boys after the loss of a few wickets early on. Feels it is difficult to make a comeback after losing so many wickets. Praises Faheem and Imad for their batting. Reckons that the pitch was a little two-paced, slow and bouncy. Says they were a bit rusty today but would be building on this experience after this match. Ends by saying that he is looking forward to the next game.

Jacob Duffy is named Player of the Match for his fine bowling performance! He says it was an awesome feeling out there. Tells that it is always daunting playing at Eden Park. Mentions that he was nervous but once he bowled the first ball, it was okay. Says the teammates have been really helpful even in the nets. Ends by saying that the people from his hometown down south have really encouraged him.

Earlier in the game, Pakistan's decision to bat first turned out a terrible one as they lost 4 inside the Powerplay. The score soon read 79 for 6 and it looked like they will collapse to a very small total but skipper Shadab led from the front and scored 42. Cameos from Imad and Ashraf took them over 150. The Kiwis were superb with the ball with debutant Duffy taking 4 while Kuggleign got 3. However, towards the end, they were smashed for a few but their starting exploits meant that the total that they stopped Pakistan to, was scaled down easily by their batters.

Pakistan started well with the ball but one would feel they were a few short. Afridi and Rauf were superb with the ball as they got 2 and 3 wickets respectively in their combined 8 overs but nothing came from the others and in the end, it was an easy win for the hosts.

Chasing the total, the Kiwis started poorly as Guptill and Conway early. Seifert though continued and along with Phillips added important runs and bailed the team out from early trouble. Phillips fell but Seifert continued and along with Chapman added 45 and kept them in the game. Seifert got to his half ton but failed to stay till the end but Neesham and Santner stayed till the end and took the team home.

A bit of stumble from the Kiwis but they have managed to keep their calm and sail through to take the lead in this 3-game series. They were spot on with the ball at the start. They got smashed for a few towards the end but with the bat, they stayed cool and calm and have gotten themselves over the line with 7 balls still left in the innings.

SIX! BANG! That's how you win the game! The skipper hits the winning run. Another short ball from Wahab but it is down the leg side. Santner swivels and pulls it over fine leg for a maximum. New Zealand win by 5 wickets.
Short ball, looks to pull but misses to get a blow on the body now. Wanted a run but Neesham said no.
Well-directed bumper! Santner looks to work it on the leg side but misses.
Low full toss, Santner chips it over cover and gets back for the second. Good running. 150 is up for the Kiwis and a boundary away from the win.
Full and wide outside off, Santner fails to reach out and connect.
Follows the batsman does Afridi as Santner looks to make room. He manages it push it down to long on for one. 6 needed in 12 balls.

NOT OUT! A fuller one on the pads, Neesham looks to flick but misses to get hit on the shoes. The ball goes towards short fine leg. They take a leg bye. Neesham was looking for the second but he slipped at the other end. In the meantime, Pakistan have opted for a review. Let's see what the replays show. No bat show Ultra Edge.
Review time! It is for LBW!
SIX BANG! Length ball in the slot and Neesham connects it well for it to carry over the mid-wicket fence. He wants to finish this game early does Neesham.
Good comeback, A slower ball around off, Neesham looks to guide it but misses.
WIDE! Afridi feeling pressure. Short ball outside off, too high. Wided.
Length ball around off, Neesham plays it towards the bowler,

FOUR? No! It's a SIX! Full and just outside off, Neesham slams it down the ground. It goes over the bowler and goes to the fence. Looks like it has hit the rope on the full. Third umpire has been called and it indeed is a biggie. Flat six.
Santner is getting some treatment here! Got hit on his finger in the last over. Here's Shaheen Afridi who will bowl out. 3-0-13-2 from him so far.

Fullish ball on the leg stump, Santner shuffles across and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple. Rauf finishes with impressive figures of 3-29 .21 runs required from the last 3 overs. Can Pakistan make a comeback?
Length ball just outside off. Neesham guides it to third man for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Neesham guides it to point.
Short ball on the leg stump, Santner tried to tuck it on the leg side, gets a leading edge which fall short of point.
Mitchell Santner, the skipper, is in now.

OUT! LBW! No bat and hitting the stumps! A simple decision. A low full toss, Chapman looks to flick but misses. They appeal and the finger is raised. Chapman as a word with his partner at the other end. Neesham suggests he take the review and he does. Replays roll in and they won't help. Chapman has to go as the Ultra Edge detects no bat and Ball Tracker shows it would've crashed into the stumps. Chapman has to go. He takes the review along with him.
Review time! Champman has been given out LBW! He reviews. No bat, confirms the Ultra Edge. Ball Tracker shows, hitting the wickets.
WIDE! Full ball but sliding down leg. Wided.
Yorker outside off stump. Dug out by Neesham for one.
FOUR! Oh Chapman is playing a blinder here! Full from Riaz and outside off. Not bowling to his field. Crunches this drive over mid off for a boundary.
Goes full and on the pads. Chapman can't get it away.
FOUR! You cannot drop those! Riaz is not happy! Short and on middle. Chapman pulls but it should be caught at deep fine leg. Faheem Ashraf drops a dolly! And they get four runs!
SIX! BANG! Slower one from Shaheen and it's driven and lofted down the ground towards the vacant long on region. Wouldn't have made a difference though! Maximum!
Opens the face of his bat and Neesham is off the mark. Outside off stump and guided to point.
On a length and on middle, Chapman takes a run on the leg side.
Wahab Riaz is back on. 2-0-21-0 are his numbers so far.
BEATEN! Good bowling from Afridi. Neesham pokes at this outside off stump and misses it.
Full and on middle, pushed through mid on for one.
James Neesham is in at no. 6.

OUT! CAUGHT! It's a slower one on middle stump and it's fuller. Seifert miscues this shot down the ground! It's an excellent catch from Faheem who runs back from mid wicket and takes it over his shoulder! Good stuff this from Afridi and he's using the pace and length effectively this over. A good knock from Seifert comes to an end.
Bumper outside off from Shaheen. He's early on the pull and only manages to hit this to long on for one.
Wider this time from Afridi but a slower one. Chapman cuts to point.
Shaheen Afridi is back to bowl now. He has figures of 2-0-11-1 so far.
Length delivery outside off and no room for Mark. Defends on the off side.
Short of a length ball on middle and leg, clipped on the on side for a single.
FOUR! Oh what a shot! Pounced on this delivery. Uses his wrists elegantly and places this ball outside off stump behind third man who has no chance even with the dive! Good shot!
Bouncer on middle and Seifert pulls hard and in the air towards deep fine leg. No chance of a catch though.
Banged short and on middle, Chapman tucks it towards square leg and gets to the other end.
Haris Rauf comes back on to bowl.
Good running! Seifert manages to guide this delivery on off stump and uses the length for a single.
Rauf has bowled this outside off and Tim smokes this straight to point on the bounce.
100 up for the Kiwi's and they're gaining momentum here! Chapman plays this delivery on middle stump to the leg side and they get a brace.
FOUR! Sweet timing! Poor line and too full from Khan. It's outside leg and he sweeps this behind fine leg for a cracking boundary!
Single again. Outside off and there for the cut. He obliges and takes a single.
Flatter on middle. Worked on the on side for one.
Floats this ball outside off. Seifert lifts this drive to deep cover for one.
Shorter on leg stump. Pulled to deep mid wicket for one.
A couple to end the over! Length ball around off, Seifert tucks it wide of the fine leg fielder. Before he can run to his left and get to the ball, they take a brace.
Back of a length and around middle, tucked on the leg side.
FIFTY FOR SEIFERT! A top knock from him so far. A fuller ball on middle, Seifert flicks it on the leg side and scampers back for the second. Fine knock but he will know that the job is half done.
Shortish and around middle, worked through square leg for a quick single.
Moves to 49 with a cut behind point for one on this length ball outside off.
FOUR! Shabby work this by the fielder at mid off. It was short of length ball, Seifert smashed it straight towards mid off, but he misfields and gives away a much needed boundary for the Kiwis.
Bowling change! Wahab Riaz is back on. 1-0-11-0 are his numbers so far.
Touch and run! Outside off stump and Seifert pushes this towards cover and runs. Has to dive at the bowler's end but Hafeez misses the direct hit!
Good length outside off. Defended back to the bowler.
FOUR! Educated edge! Almost opening the face of the bat here and third man has no chance. Ball is outside off stump and Seifert does well here. Keeps the innings ticking along.
In the air but safe! This ball is outside off and touch slower. Seifert looks to heave this away but gets an outside egde to deep backward point for a couple of runs.
Outside off and angling away. Chapman opens the face of the bat and picks up a single at third man.
Full and on middle. Driven past Faheem for one.
Good length and outside off. Played to cover for one.
FOUR! Short boundaries straight and behind the wicket here! Thickish outside edge from Tim Seifert to a ball that was outside off stump and there to be cut. He edges this for four behind third man.
Oh this is good bowling. On middle stump and no width. He can only defend this back to Rauf.
Chapman is underway! Length ball on middle stump. Tucked away to the leg side for one.
Shortish and on middle, guided down to third man for one.
Mark Chapman walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! A good length ball which Philips tries to hit it over deep mid-wicket, but doesn't time it properly to clear Shah at deep mid-wicket. Huge wicket for Pakistan as Phillips was looking good.
Change in bowling. Haris Rauf is back on. 1-0-8-1 from him so far.
Good ball to end the over. Outside off stump. Defended by Seifert. 5 off it. 89 runs required fro the last 66 balls.
FOUR! Quality from Seifert! Drives this fuller delivery past cover for four! Haris Rauf looks to cut it off and gets to it but only manages to parry it towards the boundary for four!
Cuts away a length delivery outside off for one.
This time Phillips looks for options! He looks to pull this length delivery on off stump but misses and gets hit on the body.
No room to cut for Phillips. He's bowling well to him.  Phillips just guides this ball on off stump to the point fielder.
Short and wide from Faheem. Cuts but misses the shot.
Faheem is back. Went for 4 in his first over. Can he break this stand?
Similar delivery outside off. Two dots to end the over. Glenn Phillips guides this to the point region. 8 off the over.
Goes back to a flatter trajectory and Phillips can't get this away from outside off stump. Plays towards point.
SIX! Oh my my! He's launched this way over long on! It's fuller on off stump and Tim has nailed this ball for a maximum!
Quicker, flatter and wider of off stump. He's beaten by the pace.
Phillips punches this length ball towards the cover region again.
Flatter and outside off stump. Punched away through the covers for one.
Single to end! Another flat ball around middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter and on middle, worked towards short fine leg for one.
On off, pushed towards the off side for a single.
Flatter around middle stump. Glenn guides this on the leg side for a run.
Gets on top of the bounce of this length delivery and pulls it for a couple of runs.
SIX! Short and a bad, bad ball to start the over! Punished by Phillips over deep mid wicket for a massive six!
Length ball, flicked it wide of short fine leg for a couple to end the over. New Zealand end the powerplay with 40 runs and lose 2 wickets.
Length ball on middle, played it towards the on side for no run.
FOUR! Full ball and wide too, Tim makes room and goes over the covers to collect four more.
Good length ball around off stump, played straight to the cover fielder.
Corrects his length this time, on middle, Phillips takes a run by dabbing it on the off side.
FOUR! Short and down the leg side, pulled away by Phillips towards fine leg for a boundary.
Good end to the over. Cramps him for room once again and Phillips digs this length delivery for one on the off side.
Length ball outside off. Cut away for one.
Risky! Seifert had to dive. Similar delivery from Ashraf and Phillips this time manages to place it and look for a run. The fielder fires a throw but Seifert puts in the dive to complete the run.
Bowls this shorter but no room to cut for Phillips. Manages to defend this back to the bowler.
Fuller length delivery angling into the pads. Seifert flicks this for one.
Full and wide, Seifert drives it well but finds the cover fielder.
Good length and around off, poked towards point for nothing. 8 runs and a wicket from the over.
FOUR! Crunched! What a way to get underway! Short and wide outside off, Phillips slams it through cover-point and it races away to the fence.
On a length and outside off stump. Glenn Phillips guides this to point.
Glenn Phillips is in now.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Conway is out of here this ball. A length ball around off, a tentative push from Conway and he ends up hitting it towards the left of the bowler. Rauf is alert as he takes the catch and celebrates.

NOT OUT! Is that OUT? No, it isn't! Flat line shows the Ultra Edge. What a jaffa from Rauf after getting hit for four! He's squared Conway up on this delivery and Rizwan takes it behind the stumps. Pakistan appeal vociferously but the umpire rejects. They ponder and go up for a review. The sound was off the pad and not the bat. Conway survives.
Pakistan go for the review at the last moment. It is for caught behind against Conway. Shadab wasn't too sure but the keeper was confident. Let's see if that helps Pakistan.
FOUR! What a cover drive there! It's a half volley outside off stump and this is easy for Devon. Drives this hard through the covers for four!
Bowling change! Haris Rauf is on now.
Attempts the yorker but misses by a tad bit. It's still a good ball on the pads that Conway has to dig out first ball. Manages to get it to mid on for a run to end the over.
Yorker length but wide of off stump. Tim digs this out to third man for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful timing! This is fuller and on off stump. Seifert drives this with timing down the ground past mid off. Glorious drive.
WIDE! Short and outside leg. Seifert looks to pull but misses. Wided.
Angling away and on a good length. Blocked by Tim.
Pacy full toss from Afridi on the pads and Seifert manages to get this out towards mid wicket. Afridi himself runs all the way to the 30 yard circle to cut the runs to two.
Devon Conway is in at no.3.

OUT! TAKEN! A blinder from Shadab! Guptill is the man who has been dismissed! Pakistan are off to a perfect start here. Fuller and around off, Guptill looks to hit over mid off but he doesn't time it well. It goes high in the air but it is over the fielder. Shadab races back, keeps his eyes on the ball and then takes the screamer diving forward.
Short and around middle, worked towards mid-wicket for nothing. 6 off the spinners' over.
Shortish and outside off, pushed towards the off side for one.

FOUR! Cuts it well this time and it is in the gap too! First boundary of the run chase. It is short but not too wide but Guptill does well to make room and cut it through the gap at backward point and gully.
Short and wide outside off, Guptill looks to cut but bottom edges it on the off side.
Flatter and on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Floated around off, pushed towards mid off for one.
Spin from the other end. It's Imad Wasim.

Huge appeal for a catch down the leg side but turned down. A length ball down the leg side. Martin looks to flick but misses. Rizwan catches it down the leg side and they appeal. A big and loud enquiry from Pakistan but turned down. No review. Top start from Afridi.
Seifert is off the mark on the first ball too. He pushes the fuller one towards point and takes a run.
Guptill is up and running. Shortish and just around off, he pokes it towards the off side and crosses for a run.
Landed around off on a length, worked towards mid-wicket.
Full and wide outside off, Guptill nails the drive but hits it straight to the man at mid off.
Afridi is on the money! Good length and around off, comes back in as Guptill looks to work it on the leg side but misses.
We are back for the run chase! The Pakistani players head out to the middle. Shaheen Afridi with the new ball. Martin Guptill and Tim Seifert will open for New Zealand.
